title: Knowledgable and fun tour guides
text: My friend and I really enjoyed the Skip-the-Line combo tour in Seville. Our guides were very knowledgable and had loads of personality and that made the tour that much more fun and interesting. The tour info itself was lacking unfortunately, but we figured it out with lots of questioning, reading and searching for the information. We purchased 3 tours in one payment, but the information wasn't clear about exactly where and who to meet and also, there was a hour between tour 2 and tour 3, which was not indicated by Viator. title: Great tours
text: During my stay in Sevilla, I sent to several tours arranged by pancho tours, including the tours of the cathedral and Alcázar.
